title: 2000: 'Wobbly' Millennium Bridge Closed Days After Opening
description:
'On This Day 2000: 'Wobbly' Millennium Bridge Closed Days After Opening'

The Millennium Bridge opened on this day in 2000 but when thousands of eager pedestrians rushed to use London's first new bridge in over a century, it began to wobble. 

It closed just two days later, despite architects insisting it was safe.
